reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 34. Nay or No: 6. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

I joined Mayor Rob Medina and city leaders today to announce this important milestone in Palm Bay’s recovery. There is still so https://t.co/kjnBUpdyZQ

If you were affected by flooding or need any assistance, please reach out to my office at 321-632-1776. We are here to help connect you with the resources you need.
 
Our priority is making sure families get the help they deserve. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/SsERGQdVrv

My office is here to help. If you or your family have been affected, please reach out. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/3nBgifKRRc

Despite record-breaking rainfall, we were prepared and acted quickly to help those who needed it.

Thank you to our first responders, volunteers, and everyone who answered the call to help our community during this difficult time. Your efforts made a difference! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/HTitljhOFi

I was proud to vote yes on this bill and pass it out of the House yesterday!

I’m proud to see the Good Deeds Foundation provide more than $170,000 in grants and support this year to help those who https://t.co/ZueeHqlZTo

To all who have worn the uniform, thank you for your courage, sacrifice, and dedication to protecting our freedoms. We are forever grateful.

Happy Veterans Day! https://t.co/ip5KwMvZeO

Congratulations to @GOPMajorityWhip Tom Emmer on his election as Minority Whip, @RepLisaMcClain on GOP Conference Chair, and @RepBrianJack on NRCC Chair.
 
They are tremendous leaders who bring experience, dedication, and a strong commitment to our Republican conference. Looking forward to continuing to work together! 🇺🇸

The American people deserve a government that works for them, not one held hostage by political games. It’s time to put politics aside, keep the government open, and deliver the services taxpayers deserve. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/0mKG0KUkYI

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan on becoming House Minority Leader! I look forward to continuing to work together to advance America First priorities and deliver results for the American people. https://t.co/cT9Rj42YRN

Elon Musk is driving down costs, advancing technology, and creating jobs through private-sector innovation. Florida is ready to welcome the businesses and opportunities that Democrats are pushing away in Texas. https://t.co/VhuQ7dlk6m

The best welfare program is a good-paying job! 🇺🇸 Elon Musk has spent the last 2 years bringing jobs and investments to the state of Texas. Now, Texas Democrats are playing politics, standing in the way of new opportunities and economic growth. https://t.co/q3uUCCHwOf

250 years of honor, courage, and commitment. 🇺🇸

Today, we celebrate the birthday of the United States Marine Corps and recognize the generations of Marines who have defended our nation and protected our freedoms. https://t.co/28l4XELc8c

After a week of working alongside local, state, and federal officials, we have a formal request for a Major Disaster Declaration for Brevard County and other Florida communities devastated by the historic flooding. I’m grateful to Governor Ron DeSantis for taking this important step and urge President Trump to approve this request as quickly as possible! 

Read the full letter ⬇️
https://t.co/zV76XpEcbZ

I spoke with the Governor’s office again today, and I expect Governor DeSantis to sign the FEMA disaster declaration one the total cost of damage is confirmed.
 
I’ll continue working with state and local officials to help get Brevard County the federal assistance our residents need as soon as possible. 🇺🇸

As recovery efforts continue across Brevard County, help is available for residents impacted by the flooding.

Residents can request FREE volunteer cleanup assistance, and curbside debris pickup in flood-impacted unincorporated areas begins Tuesday, November 10.

If you need help or want to learn more, see the resources below ⬇️

Today, we recognize the students, teachers, and educators inspiring the next generation of scientists, engineers, and innovators.

Investing in STEM education means investing in America's future. Let's keep encouraging young minds to explore, create, and push the boundaries of https://t.co/K5Dbi4OQ27

It was great to speak with Secretary Duffy at Max Power about the exciting opportunities ahead for our  nation’s space program! 🚀

Together, we will continue working to keep America #1 in space. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/8pFYqLwRMI
And always call our office at (321)632-1776 if you have questions!

My office has been working closely with the mayors of Palm Bay and West Melbourne, Brevard County officials, other local leaders, and federal officials at FEMA to assess the damage and coordinate recovery efforts. We have also been in direct communication with Governor DeSantis

The future of aerospace, innovation, and technology is happening right HERE on Florida’s Space Coast. 

I was honored to join @NASAAdmin Jared Isaacman and leaders from across the air and space industry at Max Power for the exciting announcement of Cape Week coming March 2028!🚀🇺🇸

Thank you to the people of Florida’s 8th Congressional District for your continued trust and support. It is the honor of a lifetime to represent our communities in the United States Congress.

Central Florida is home, and I am proud to serve the hardworking families who make Brevard and Orange counties so special. I will continue working every day to ensure your voices are heard in Washington.
📺 TUNE IN: I’ll be joining @foxandfriends on @FoxNews with Griff Jenkins and Charlie Hurt LIVE from Cape Canaveral at 8:50AM! https://t.co/hQpp0si5zD
FOR MORE DISASTER RESOURCE INFORMATION VISIT: https://t.co/Ikqo2pZ5QO https://t.co/8gheEvZt4S

I have been in contact with local, state, and federal partners to ensure our community has access to the resources and support it needs.

I encourage all Brevard County residents to stay informed and visit the Brevard County Emergency Management website for the latest updates and emergency information.

https://t.co/sF3jDtnXSu

Due to thunderstorms and flooding across the area, Brevard County Schools are closed today.

Please stay safe, avoid flooded roadways, and monitor local weather updates as conditions develop.

For the latest weather alerts and updates, visit:
https://t.co/v7xWpeV11K

Fall back, Florida! 🍂⏰

Daylight Saving Time ends tonight. Remember to turn your clocks back one hour and enjoy that extra hour! https://t.co/nk85jKEyeC
Halloween is a great time to enjoy the traditions that bring our communities together. Wishing everyone in FL-08 a fun and safe night with family, friends, and neighbors! 👻🎃 https://t.co/74VGYuJVMR

My wife and I were honored to welcome home our veterans following the 90th Honor Flight since 2010. 🇺🇸
 
Their sacrifices helped shape our country and deserve our gratitude every day. Thank you to everyone who makes these Honor Flights possible and ensures our veterans receive the recognition they deserve!

America’s future in space is full of opportunity! 🚀
 
I was proud to participate in the 4th Annual Space Economy Summit at the University of Central Florida and discuss how space innovation will create new jobs, drive  economic growth, and keep America at the forefront of https://t.co/0g5HgYY2Mh

America’s economy is surging! 📈

The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in Q3—its fastest pace in a year!

Let’s keep the momentum going! 🚀🇺🇸 https://t.co/odKlouFqag

On First Responders Day, we honor the brave men and women who put their lives on the line to protect our communities. Their courage, selflessness, and unwavering dedication remind us of the true meaning of service. Thank you for all you do to keep Florida families safe! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/XXAJYLsWqS

$414 MILLION for Florida’s Space Coast! These investments are supporting clean waterways, stronger infrastructure, improved roads and transportation, and safer communities across our district. I will continue working to deliver results for YOU! https://t.co/GMqvfEIf3k

Delivering results for Florida’s 8th District! 🇺🇸
 
My office has helped return $20.7 million to your pockets! If you’re facing a problem with a federal agency, my team is ready to help. https://t.co/GYtK25MYCC

Florida is the Free State for a reason. No state income tax, strong schools, and the freedom to make decisions for your family. We won't let failed socialist policies take that away. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/bSryne1lD9

Democrats put on a mask to get elected, then go right back to their radical ways.

Republicans are working to secure the border, crack down on fraud, and put more money back in your pockets. Let's keep America moving FORWARD! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/lETr5nzhlM

I enjoyed touring the Limbitless Solutions Lab at the University of Central Florida and learning more about their innovative work. It’s great to see organizations in our community cutting-edge technology to improve lives through engineering and innovation. https://t.co/kLfC3Fv6aD

Earlier this month, I had the opportunity to attend the launch of Crew-13 to the International Space Station from right here on Florida’s Space Coast.

Missions like this showcase the engineers, technicians, scientists, and countless others who are advancing American leadership in space and opening new doors for discovery. I’m proud to represent this world-class workforce and the communities that make these historic achievements possible.

I am proud to join @VP JD Vance in signing the Pledge to Protect Americans from Fraud.
 
We must protect hardworking American taxpayers and ensure taxpayer dollars go toward helping those in need, not into the hands of bad actors. https://t.co/4eKgotLihH

The Cocoa rail station is now a reality and the thousands of jobs that will come with it. 

Thank you to the local leaders, the Federal Railroad Administration and Florida Department of Transportation for recognizing our efforts to bring the Cocoa Multimodal Station to life. This project will create jobs, strengthen our local economy, and deliver lasting benefits to our district.
 
I look forward to continuing our work together to expand transportation opportunities and create jobs across the district.

I joined Second Harvest Food Bank for their “Hunger Never Sleeps” event in Orlando last month.  Proud to work alongside dedicated volunteers helping provide meals to families in need across Central Florida. Thank you to Second Harvest and everyone working to fight hunger in our communities!

Honored to attend the Brevard No One Left Behind Memorial Service at Cape Canaveral National Cemetery, where we paid tribute to veterans who passed away without family present. Every veteran deserves to be remembered and laid to rest with dignity and respect. Their service and sacrifice will never be forgotten. 🇺🇸

Great visiting No Limits Academy in Melbourne to see how they're helping children with complex physical disabilities learn and thrive! Thank you to Laura Joslin and Roberta Neves for their dedication to making a difference for children and families across Brevard County! https://t.co/rvl56jrU1O

🚀 Another incredible morning on Florida’s Space Coast!
 
This morning’s SpaceX Falcon 9 launch from right here in our district created a breathtaking, once-in-a-lifetime view over the Banana River as it carried supplies to the International Space Station.
 
Proud to represent the community at the heart of America’s future in space!

Happy 251st Birthday to the U.S. Navy! For generations, our sailors have defended our nation, protected our freedoms, and kept America safe. Today, we honor their courage, sacrifice, and unwavering commitment to our country. 🇺🇸⚓ https://t.co/NXJqIoO2Fm

Great to join Mayor Andrea Young and the West Melbourne City Council to highlight the $1.25 million in federal funding I secured for the city’s new Reverse Osmosis Water Production Facility!

This important investment will help West Melbourne develop an independent water source, improve water quality, and strengthen critical infrastructure for years to come.
The future of American space exploration is brighter than ever on Florida’s Space Coast! 🚀 https://t.co/6SHelIZW8k

With companies like SpaceX, Blue Origin, and Relativity Space expanding their presence in Brevard County, having the right infrastructure in place is essential to supporting continued growth and job creation.

A proposed natural gas pipeline could help reduce hundreds of fuel truck trips, improve roadway safety, and support future launches. 

Our Space Coast is growing, and we must make sure our infrastructure is ready for the future! 🚀

Great to join the Greater Palm Bay Chamber of Commerce for their monthly luncheon. Thank you to Chamber President Cory Skeates and the entire Chamber for bringing our Space Coast business community together for these important conversations! https://t.co/cro99W3MBP

The spirit of exploration and the pursuit of new opportunities are part of America’s story. Columbus Day is an opportunity to reflect on our nation’s history and the many events and people that have shaped America. May we continue building a future that honors our founding ideals and shared American values. 🇺🇸

Brevard County is mourning the tragic loss of Deputy Kevin Morris, a dedicated law enforcement officer who devoted his life to serving and protecting our community.

As the son of a law enforcement officer, this loss hits especially close to home. I had the privilege of knowing Kevin and seeing firsthand his commitment to keeping our community safe.

My heart breaks for his family, his fellow deputies, and the entire Brevard County Sheriff's Office. Please join me in keeping them in your thoughts and prayers during this incredibly difficult time.

We will never forget his service and sacrifice.

Our thoughts and prayers are with Brevard County Sheriff’s Agent Kevin Morris and his family during this difficult time. Kevin served our community with distinction as a senior homicide agent, dedicating himself to protecting others. May he rest in peace, and may his family find comfort and strength in the days ahead. 

We are deeply grateful to all law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. Their courage, dedication, and sacrifice will never be forgotten.

On World Mental Health Day, it is important to recognize that mental health is an essential part of overall well-being. By raising awareness, reducing stigma, and providing people with support, we can make a meaningful difference in the lives of all Americans. https://t.co/jQ8HlWCjOi

It was an honor to join the Children’s Advocacy Center of Brevard to recognize three decades of making a difference in the lives of our most vulnerable children.

As a father, I know there is nothing more important than keeping our kids safe.

Thank you for 30 years of service to our community!

Bringing federal dollars back home and expanding housing opportunities for Brevard County! 🇺🇸
 
My team and I worked closely with the Brevard Homeless Coalition, local community partners, and HUD to help get this critical investment across the finish line. This funding will help put roofs over the heads of some of our most vulnerable neighbors and provide a path toward long-term stability.

Great to join the hardworking men and women of L3Harris in Melbourne for a town hall discussion on the future of American defense and space innovation!

The incredible talent right here in Brevard County is critical to keeping America safe and ensuring our nation continues to lead the world in space. 🚀

I am heartbroken by the tragic loss of 5-year-old Bellamy Dawkins-Morris at Riviera Elementary School in Palm Bay. My thoughts and prayers go out to Bellamy’s family, loved ones, and the entire school community during this incredibly difficult time.

Congratulations to NASA’s Crew-12 on a safe return to Earth! Four heroic astronauts spent 237 days aboard the International Space Station, conducting important research and helping improve the orbiting laboratory.

Their dedication and perseverance continue to push the boundaries of human exploration. Welcome home, Crew-12! 🚀🌎
https://t.co/Gq2YTMIHcv
Great to join local leaders at Accelerate Brevard’s State of the Cities to discuss the priorities shaping Brevard County and the future of our Space Coast! 🚀🌴 https://t.co/gXvXkfaCk1

Congratulations to Prime Minister @narendramodi  on 25 years of public service! 🇺🇸🇮🇳 Wishing him continued success as the United States and India work together to strengthen our partnership and advance our shared interests. https://t.co/OR5vngW5no
